loss_semantics: Original CE plus lambda=.3 times detached p(original label) times (1-cos(raw first-round state, detached input embedding of original label)), averaged over original valid supervised positions. Matched CE uses the same target/position/weight rule and differentiable native readout. No intermediate bridge annotations, no confidence-sum renormalization.
kv_semantics: First-round same-layer cache diagonal j=i only; full current causal bank j<=i. One shared softmax; gradients connected; cache rebuilt each forward; no extra parameters.
discoloop_semantics: At the one nonfinal boundary add alpha=1 times nonaffine RMSNorm(eps=1e-6) of softmax(native ln_f(h) E^T/tau=1) E. Preserve residual and full gradients. No channel after final round. GPT/Wang adaptation, not original-paper full reproduction.
